reviews.title: Popup
reviews.text: This app won’t let me add photos anymore because a popup trying to get me to buy another version of this app that cost money. I can click on I don’t want it, however it won’t go away. I don’t want that. I like the free app until it started this mess. It is so aggravating. Please fix it.

reviews.title: Keeps everything organized
reviews.text:
This is the best Christmas app I have found so far without to much confusion. I would have rated it 5 stars but I cannot figure out how to start a new gift list for a new year. It says you can view previous years. The app kept me organized last year and now I would like to figure out how I can start a new list for this year without deleting my previous list.
Editing this review to 5 stars. My question was answered quickly, once I knew how to archive it was easy to do now I can set up my list for this year. Win Win. Thanks for the help. Great app!
Update: 2025 - this was a good app but no longer. I lost all my archives for the past several years (I wrote to them with no response). There is nothing left to this app. They even took away my gift recipient names.To bad.

reviews.title: Fake virus pop up ad
reviews.text: Loved this app and have used it for a number of years but this year one of the adverts brought up a fake virus warning image that made it appear like a virus warning pop up, which was concerning.

reviews.title: Was good but no more
reviews.text:
Was a decent app but now does not sync between iPhone and iPad so no longer working for me. 
Need to look for something more suitable.  Disappointed.
